description: Home cyber defense from a portable USB key, written in Rust, in active development. Hardens your PCs, audits your network (Internet exposure, Wi-Fi, DNS, devices), explains each risk plainly and fixes it with your OK, undoably. Hunts malware and intruders, blocks threats in one click; never attacks. Windows · Linux · macOS · FR/EN
